name: CFG_UseReeds
comment: TRUE = wait for reed switches; FALSE = timed moves (CFG_TravelTime)

name: CFG_UseMagSensor
comment: TRUE = BPRS-620 fibre amp on DI-6; FALSE = infer empty when no part reaches IS/CS

name: CFG_MetalToUpper
comment: TRUE = metal -> 2A upper ejector / plastic -> 3A lower; FALSE swaps

name: CFG_EStopFitted
comment: FALSE only for bench tests with no E-stop patched (unsafe)

name: CFG_EStopNC
comment: TRUE = E-stop contact on DI-3 is NC (ON when healthy)

name: CFG_TravelTime
comment: Timed-move mode: coil hold time that counts as end of stroke

name: CFG_MoveTimeout
comment: Reed mode: fault if a move takes longer

name: CFG_DetectSettle
comment: Wait after feed retract before reading IS-01/CS-01

name: CFG_DetectWindow
comment: Give up detecting after this long

name: CFG_EmptyDebounce
comment: Part-present must be OFF this long to call the magazine empty

name: CFG_FeedDelay
comment: Pause in WaitPart before feeding (lets the stack settle)

name: HMI_Start
comment: Writable command coil (cleared by PLC each scan)

name: HMI_Stop
comment: Writable command coil (cleared by PLC each scan)

name: HMI_Reset
comment: Writable command coil (cleared by PLC each scan)
